text_block_list.text:
What do you take me for? That wasn't
nearly
enough to exhaust me.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Once we get back to the academy, we'll
analyze
this race. You go on ahead.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I... want to cool down a bit before
heading back.
I'll catch up to you, so no
need to wait for me.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув claims she isn't tired, but her
behavior
says otherwise. It might be
worth adjusting her
schedule.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
